name: Sensuous Charm
body:
You are quite talented in appealing to the carnal instincts of others.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 bonus to Bluff and Diplomacy checks and a +2 bonus to Perform (dance). If you have 10 or more ranks in one of these skills, that bonus is doubled.
